name: Delhi

nextRevision.basis: The 22 October 2019 notification adds dearness allowance twice a year, on 1 April and 1 October, from the six-monthly average consumer price index. The Labour Department's current-rates page, checked on 16 October 2026, lists no order after the one effective from 1 April 2025, so the revisions due on 1 October 2025, 1 April 2026 and 1 October 2026 had not been published by then.

sources.legalBasis: Minimum Wages Act, 1948, section 5(1)(b), after the Supreme Court's order of 14 October 2019. The document is headed 'Order' and signed on 23 October 2019; its rates apply from the date of notification, 22 October 2019, and later orders cite it as dated 22 October 2019

tables.vdaNote: Delhi's order gives the rate in force and the DA added at each revision. Here, the base is the rate fixed by the 22 October 2019 notification, and DA is everything added since.

verification: 2026-10-16: Labour Department, GNCTD, 'Current Minimum Wage Rate' page (labour.delhi.gov.in/labour/current-minimum-wage-rate, page last updated 14/10/2026) lists order F.No.(142)/02/MW/VII/Part file/211-241 dated 15/04/2025, w.e.f. 01/04/2025, as its most recent minimum wage order.

2026-10-16: da15april2025.pdf (text layer) read in full. Rates from 01.04.2025: unskilled 18456 per month and 710 per day, semi-skilled 20371 and 784, skilled 22411 and 862; clerical non-matriculate 20371 and 784, matriculate not graduate 22411 and 862, graduate and above 24356 and 937. DA added from 01.04.2025: 390, 442, 494 (clerical 442, 494, 520) on rates as on 01.10.2024 of 18066, 19929, 21917 (clerical 19929, 21917, 23836). CPI average July-December 2024: 413.42, an increase of 11.32 points. Signed K.M. Singh, Joint Labour Commissioner (HQ). The order's own number field is blank in the scan; the number is from the department's listing.

2026-10-16: 5da.pdf (scanned, read by OCR and checked by eye). Headed 'ORDER', number 12(142)/02/MW/VII/3636, signed and dated by hand 23/10/2019; the department's listing gives the date as 23-10-2019. Rates from 22.10.2019 (the date of notification): unskilled 14806 per month and 569 per day, semi-skilled 16284 and 626, skilled 17924 and 689; clerical non-matriculate 16284, matriculate not graduate 17924, graduate and above 19522. DA due on 1 April and 1 October from six-monthly CPI averages.

2026-10-16: da_oct_2024.pdf (scanned, OCR and checked by eye). Rates as on 01.04.2024: 17988, 19825, 21813. From 01.10.2024: 18066 and 695, 19929 and 767, 21917 and 843; clerical 19929, 21917, 23836. The order itself prints 21,927 for matriculates from 01.10.2024 (a typo in the order, checked at 300 dpi); 21813 + 104 = 21917, and the 15 April 2025 order uses 21917 as the rate on 01.10.2024.
